top_signals.title: OpenAI says its new GPT 5.6 models are becoming more cost-efficient
top_signals.summary: OpenAI says it has reduced the price of two GPT-5.6 models, cutting Luna's API price by 80% and Terra's by 20% as it works to make its models more efficient. [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
